description: Header shell with branch opening: the plate outline was drawn with the circumference along x while the opening was computed with the header axis along x, so the opening sat at (station, circumference) inside a (circumference, length) rectangle: wrong position, turned a quarter turn. No check compared the two frames, so every gate that could run passed and the DXF carried the error. Found on 2026-11-19 by an independent reviewer comparing a screen capture with an independently drawn pattern; fixed in uem develop::header_with_opening, with two new verifier checks on the outline extents.
